window.note: Hall-only particle-free pre-run 0.75 ns -> T_on, then a fresh native genesis and the coupled window

assumptions.plasma_cells_note: particles per cell over the 5 mm x 5 mm x 25 mm gap volume (cells transverse x 4 axial)

projected.field_floor: measured resident vacuum step minus the host independent residual (assumed moved to a device-side compensated residual) and minus the host total-field digests (assumed device-side block digests)

station.gpu: RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell (sm_120), 24 GB, 672 GB/s (public specification, not measured here)
station.note: device-bound parts scaled by the memory-bandwidth ratio to the RTX 3080 Ti (912 GB/s); host single-thread speed assumed equal to the Ryzen 7 9850X3D (range 1.0-1.3x slower); members run concurrently up to the 24 GB device memory and a device-busy sum <= 1

zenobia.gpu: RTX 3080 Ti, 12 GB (shared with other work; about 1.6 GB in use by others at measurement time)
zenobia.note: Power-Flow cores 6-7, one member per core

hall_v31_record.source: Hall v3.1 RESULTS sections 5 and 9: coupled 2 carriers 10.2 ms vs vacuum 2.80 ms per step at 200 um; 1e4 -> 1e5 carriers slope 5.3 us per carrier (GPU push)
